scraped.scraped_description: Helping government teams create and run great digital services that meet the Service Standard.

name: Service Manual
tagline: Guidance for UK government teams to create and run great public services meeting the Service Standard
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: machinery of government reorganisations (GDS moved to DSIT 2024)
awards: Recognized as best practice in digital government transformation

policy_outcomes.description: Service Manual establishes and enforces the Service Standard for UK government digital services

outcome_methodology: Compliance tracking and audit of UK government digital services against Service Standard criteria
published_performance_metrics: Service Standard compliance rates across UK government departments
curation_criteria: Content curated by UK Government Digital Service based on digital service best practices and government policy requirements
contributor_governance: Contributions managed by GDS with input from government digital teams
controversies: Ongoing debate about mandatory vs advisory application to devolved/local government
GDS influence perceived to have declined post-2016 following senior leadership departures
political_relevance_summary: Service Manual addresses government technology and public service delivery. Guidance for UK government teams to create and run great public services meeting the Service Standard.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides technical infrastructure supporting civic technology ecosystem.

generalizability_notes: Currently focused on United Kingdom; methodology-based approach is inherently transferable.
